Consistent with the length-well diagnosis: these instances need excursions that a shortest-first beam discards. Next test is an eye-ranked beam (collapse floor and orbit lane instead of total length).
claim: A width-1,500, depth-100, cap-64 length-ranked beam with the radius-7 target basin finds a route for any of the 58 live k=1 records of 100+ moves with initial length <= 19.
